# ==== Treaties in the Himalayas (formerly nesnd_india_frontier.txt) ====
# Bhutan and Nepal with Mughal: requests for the trade privilege and for military access, and the
# treaties already signed. Held by Bhutan, Nepal and Mughal (any country for which nesnd_india_empire
# holds); added each month by nesnd_india_frontier_upkeep from nesnd_india_refresh. It has neither
# possible nor is_shown_when_inactive, so no instance exists until then.
# The reason lines are generated by the workbench script
# reports/2026-11-21-india-development/喜马拉雅/build_journal.py. Since the India closing batch this file
# is edited directly; the script reads the old file layout and is no longer run.

            triggered_desc = { trigger = { nesnd_india_empire = yes exists = scope:india_frontier_bhu c:BHU ?= { nesnd_india_matter_stage_value = 2 nesnd_india_matter_kind_value = 2 exists = var:nesnd_india_matter_to var:nesnd_india_matter_to = root exists = var:nesnd_india_matter_await } } desc = nesnd_india_frontier_status_bhu_2_consent }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { nesnd_india_empire = yes exists = scope:india_frontier_bhu c:BHU ?= { nesnd_india_matter_stage_value = 3 nesnd_india_matter_kind_value = 2 exists = var:nesnd_india_matter_to var:nesnd_india_matter_to = root exists = var:nesnd_india_matter_await } } desc = nesnd_india_frontier_status_bhu_2_answer }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { nesnd_india_empire = yes exists = scope:india_frontier_bhu c:BHU ?= { nesnd_india_matter_stage_value = 3 nesnd_india_matter_kind_value = 4 exists = var:nesnd_india_matter_to var:nesnd_india_matter_to = root exists = var:nesnd_india_matter_await } } desc = nesnd_india_frontier_status_bhu_4_answer }

            triggered_desc = { trigger = { nesnd_india_empire = yes exists = scope:india_frontier_nep c:NEP ?= { nesnd_india_matter_stage_value = 3 nesnd_india_matter_kind_value = 5 exists = var:nesnd_india_matter_to var:nesnd_india_matter_to = root exists = var:nesnd_india_matter_await } } desc = nesnd_india_frontier_status_nep_5_answer }
            desc = nesnd_india_frontier_status_none
        }
        # Mughal, when Bhutan and Nepal both have a request to us waiting: the line above names Bhutan's,
        # this one Nepal's.
        first_valid = {
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { nesnd_india_empire = yes exists = scope:india_frontier_nep nesnd_india_frontier_both_ask_us = yes c:NEP ?= { nesnd_india_matter_stage_value = 2 nesnd_india_matter_kind_value = 2 } } desc = nesnd_india_frontier_status_also_nep_2_consent }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { nesnd_india_empire = yes exists = scope:india_frontier_nep nesnd_india_frontier_both_ask_us = yes c:NEP ?= { nesnd_india_matter_stage_value = 3 nesnd_india_matter_kind_value = 2 } } desc = nesnd_india_frontier_status_also_nep_2_answer }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { nesnd_india_empire = yes exists = scope:india_frontier_nep nesnd_india_frontier_both_ask_us = yes c:NEP ?= { nesnd_india_matter_stage_value = 3 nesnd_india_matter_kind_value = 4 } } desc = nesnd_india_frontier_status_also_nep_4_answer }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { nesnd_india_empire = yes exists = scope:india_frontier_nep nesnd_india_frontier_both_ask_us = yes c:NEP ?= { nesnd_india_matter_stage_value = 3 nesnd_india_matter_kind_value = 5 } } desc = nesnd_india_frontier_status_also_nep_5_answer }
            desc = nesnd_india_frontier_status_blank
        }
    }

    scripted_button = nesnd_india_frontier_trade_button
    scripted_button = nesnd_india_frontier_access_bhu_button
    scripted_button = nesnd_india_frontier_access_nep_button

    # Neither Bhutan or Nepal with a Mughal government in the world, nor Mughal with one of them.
    outcome = {
        flags = { hidden invalid_outcome }
        conclusion_desc = nesnd_india_frontier_void_conclusion
        trigger = { NOT = { nesnd_india_frontier_holder = yes } }
    }

    on_monthly_pulse = {
        effect = {
            c:BHU ?= { save_scope_as = india_frontier_bhu } c:NEP ?= { save_scope_as = india_frontier_nep }
            nesnd_india_frontier_ai_asks = yes
        }
    }
}

# ==== Overseas trade (formerly nesnd_india_overseas.txt) ====

# directions for a trade privilege or a treaty port. Added each month by nesnd_india_overseas_upkeep from
# nesnd_india_refresh; it has neither possible nor is_shown_when_inactive, so no instance exists until then.
# First generated by the workbench script reports/2026-11-21-india-development/海外通商/build_overseas.py.
# Since the India closing batch this part is edited directly; the script is no longer run.
